name: A_FETCH_CRTSH
description: Certificate-transparency search via crt.sh (typosquat / shadow-IT discovery). Input: domain. crt.sh is keyless, so the stub gate is the CRTSH_LIVE env flag instead of an API key: unset (or not '1') returns a canned 2-cert fixture; CRTSH_LIVE=1 queries crt.sh live. Diverges from the API-key stub pattern by design.
